title: Infra + Console weekly sync: agenda + action log (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose / objectives:
- Quick alignment across infra + console + runtime on anything that risks our SLOs this week (p95 latency, tail errors, model hotload failures).
- Capture action items and owners; short checks in next sync.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick metrics snapshot (5m) — Diego
   - p95 token latency trend last 48h (prod-hosted): currently 185ms -> up to 230ms in eu-west-1 spike at 06:30 UTC. Suspect a slow kernel pick on g4dn clusters.
   - Errors: 0.07% 5xx, majority are kv-cache miss + OOM during long-seq jobs (ENG-4821)
   - Throughput: tokens/sec decreased ~8% post-batching tweak (was expected)

2) Canary results + rollouts (7m) — Aisha
   - Canary for console rollouts (v2 metrics) finished: UI latency OK, but traces show increased client-side websocket reconnects (slack:#console-room thread).
   - Rollback window open until Fri 23:59 PDT.

3) Serving runtime infra items (7m) — Samir
   - Kernel selector fix PR 2114 merged to staging; need canary on dedicated cluster (small 10-node).
   - Autoscaler observed overshoot during burst window — tuning proposal attached (see linked PR).

4) Private deploys / customer requests (4m) — Ellie
   - Customer X wants private deployment checklist updated for KMS rotation; add KMS docs + test plan.

5) Open blockers & quick syncs (5m) — round robin
   - Load-test infra for quantized models still flaky (long tail).
   - Need decision on enabling prefix caching by default for low-latency tier (pros/cons).

Notes to self / talking points for 1:1 with Kiran (infra lead):
- Ask about timeline for procurement of additional H100s (budget note in Finance).
- Push for temporary extra capacity in eu-west-1 for 2 weeks to blunt latency spikes.
- Bring up possibility of promoting kernel-selector fix to hotfix if canary shows >10% p95 improvement.

Ad-hoc items / scratch ideas:
- Experiment: route small seq requests to a low-latency optimized pool even if slightly more expensive — measure cost per p95 delta.
- Quick grep: find recent "kv-cache miss" logs across last 72h (todo: add query to observability runbook).
- Draft a short customer-facing note for Private customers about KMS rotation impact (Ellie to draft).

Action items (live tracking) — format: [status] task — owner — due
- [open] Confirm eu-west-1 temporary capacity request & estimated cost — Diego — 2026-03-12
- [open] Run dedicated canary for kernel-selector PR 2114 (10-node) and report p95 delta — Samir — 2026-03-13
- [in_progress] Update Console rollback runbook to include websocket reconnect mitigation steps — Aisha — 2026-03-11
- [open] Add KMS rotation test checklist to Private deployment repo + notify security — Ellie — 2026-03-15
- [open] Add observability query for kv-cache miss 72h window and pin to dashboard — Diego / SRE — 2026-03-12
- [open] Triage load-test failures for quantized models; attach logs to ENG-4821 — Samir — 2026-03-14

Unresolved questions (to surface in sync):
- Do we enable default prefix caching for low-latency tier? (need perf numbers + cost model)
- If kernel-selector hotfix helps, what's the rollback plan for older nodes without updated runtime?

Prep checklist (things to grab before the meeting):
- Dashboard links: prod p95, eu-west-1 heatmap, tokens/sec (pinned to my dashboard)
- Link to PR 2114 and canary configs (GitHub and staging cluster config)
- List of impacted customer tenants for Private deploys (Ellie)
- Recent incident notes: 2026-03-08 spikes doc (for context)

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy-paste for meeting notes):
- Summary: (one-liner on outcome)
- Decisions made: (short bullets)
- Action items: (list with owner + due date)
- Blocking items requiring exec escalation: (flag if any)

Random scratch (notes to self):
- Might schedule 1:1 with Aisha to go over rollback runbook improvements — add to my calendar.
- Write short blurb for next weekly "runtime status" to include a note about canary and kernel selector.

References / quick links (for meeting):
- ENG ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4821
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2114
- Slack thread: slack://channel?team=T1234&id=C98765 (console-room websocket reconnects)
- Confluence: Console-dashboard-rollouts-2026

Last quick thoughts (scratch):
- Keep this doc lightweight. If anything becomes formal/decisioned, move to shared_drives/engineering/observability or product docs.
- Mark action items done inline when complete (helps for next-week handoff).

---
End of scratchpad (will copy to meeting notes after sync).
